claims.claim: The `a` element represents a hyperlink when it has an `href` attribute.
Relative URL references are resolved against a base URL, normally the document URL.
Link purpose should be determinable from link text alone or with programmatically determined context, subject to WCAG exceptions.
The `_blank` target opens a new browsing context, and `rel=noopener` prevents the opened page from obtaining `window.opener`.
A fragment reference can identify a location within a resource.
